name: web-sky-clouds-fintech-landing-page-long
title: Cloudy Sky Fintech Landing Page
whatItIs: A long, airy landing page for a fintech app set on a cloud-filled sky: hero with a hand-held phone and floating cards, feature statements, transfer UI, pricing plans, testimonials and a closing download section.
whatItMeans: Sky and cloud imagery signal openness and calm, and light navy text on white cards stays trustworthy.
techniques: Cloud photography as a section backdrop
Floating stat cards around the phone
Two-tier pricing cards with a highlighted plan
Testimonial row cropped at the edges

vocabulary.definition: A sky or cloud image used as a mood-setting background.
A pricing card elevated to steer choice.
Cards cut off at the edge to imply more.
